headings.rules: Use tight tracking (tracking-tight) and weights ranging from light (font-light) for elegance to black (font-black) for impact. NEVER use Inter or generic default sans for headings.

body.rules: Loose leading (leading-relaxed) for maximum readability and accessibility.

colors.rules: Follow Organic & Earthy archetype. Base is Bone-white/Sand. Primary is Deep Forest Green for trust. Accent is Terracotta for energetic calls-to-action.

layouts.homepage: Bento-grid modular layout. Large hero with organic asymmetry. Use col-span-full md:col-span-8 for hero, col-span-4 for supporting modules (e.g., local farm stories). Mobile-first navigation with bottom tabs or easy thumb-zone actions.
layouts.marketplace: Image-first product cards displaying farm origin and harvest data. Persistent mini-cart for frictionless shopping. Clean CSS Grid (grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4) with generous gap-6.
layouts.seller_dashboard: High Density Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4). Tight gaps (gap-4). Every pixel utilized, h-full on children for uniform widget rows.
layouts.checkout_tracking: Linear, progressive disclosure flows. Use clear status steppers for order tracking (Ordered, Packed, Rider Assigned, Delivered).
layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Tailwind Scale p-6, p-8, p-12. Containers with borders MUST have internal padding.

surfaces.cards: Neumorphic/Clay hybrid. Flat background matching parent or white, 1px subtle border (border-border), no default shadow. On hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and ambient soft shadow (shadow-lg).
surfaces.headers: Crystal Glassmorphism if content scrolls under (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 with 1px delicate inner border-white/40). If solid, use flat background with hard bottom border. NEVER fully transparent.
surfaces.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or softly rounded (rounded-lg). Solid colors for primary actions, explicit hover text/bg contrast shifts.

component_instructions.forms: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select primitives (in .js/.jsx). Strip default Vercel-look; apply custom earthy borders and focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/20).
component_instructions.dropdowns_modals: Solid backgrounds ONLY. Never transparent. Use Shadcn DropdownMenu, Dialog.
component_instructions.toasts: Use Sonner for toast notifications (checkout success, rider assignment).
component_instructions.icons: Use lucide-react for functional UI. Avoid overusing icons where clear typography suffices.
component_instructions.navigation: Visible top navigation bar on desktop (Logo + 3-5 links + Cart/Profile). Fixed header with z-50. Hamburger menus reserved for mobile only.

visual_enhancers.textures: Incorporate subtle CSS noise or grain overlay (opacity-5) on hero backgrounds to kill digital flatness and enhance the 'farm-fresh' tactile feel.
visual_enhancers.motion: Framer-motion for route transitions, micro-interactions, hover states, and staggered entrance of marketplace products. Always respect prefers-reduced-motion.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 for normal text (WCAG AA).
accessibility.interactive: Explicit hover states (e.g., hover:bg-primary/90 hover:text-white). Focus rings required (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/50).
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='checkout-submit-button').

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) ONLY where appropriate, NEVER fully transparent backgrounds on interactive overlays.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component should be placed in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx (or .js).
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute for robust automated testing.
